title: Representing a ring as the endomorphism ring of an abelian group
summary: We investigate Baer's realization problem for almost free abelian groups, focusing on the extent to which rings can be represented as endomorphism rings under strong freeness conditions. Building on earlier work that relied on additional set-theoretic principles such as the diamond or strong black boxes, we develop new methods that significantly weaken these assumptions.
